name: Eyez,Inc.
summary: EYEZ, Inc. is a Japanese company that operates digital platforms, mainly in the advertising industry. They include Media Radar, Trami for word-of-mouth marketing, Cloud Radar and Global Radar, plus Weekle for activities and experiences and information media such as mamaPRESS. It also provides management-based advertising agency services. Dating from 2007, it has its headquarters in Shibuya, Japan.
